utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: You got it — I’ll bring the tape and check the signup table.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo — I’ll bring gloves and a hammer, and I can help wherever you need me at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — thanks, Mara. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely happening, then? Just checking I’ve got the repair drive right.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s on. I’ll send the details if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just wanted to confirm it’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would really help, Vik. If you send the timing and the who-brings-what list, I can keep an eye on the logistics from here.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — I’ll send the timing and who-brings-what list next, and you can check it for any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll watch for gaps and flag anything that looks off. Once I see it, I can help make sure the timing and supplies all line up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s still on and it’s coming together nicely. If you hear of anyone who wants to help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, definitely happening — still ironing out a few fixes, but it’s moving along. If you want, I can keep you posted as things get locked in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep you posted with any other details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just send any extra details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll send the extra details as soon as I have them and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ve got the gloves and hammer ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, perfect—thanks, Mara. I’ll check what’s left to do for the repair drive and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Noah — just let me know what’s left, and I’ll be there with the gloves and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — alley lamps first, then the squeaky gate. Anything else after that?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I think that’s the main bit for now — if I remember anything else, I’ll tell you. Thanks, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll stick with those two for now and check back if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for reminding me. I can check on the pickup, and you can handle the timing, then we’ll sort the donations together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, Oren. I’ll keep the timing straight, and if you can confirm pickup, we should be in pretty good shape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep — I’ll check on the pickup and let you know as soon as I hear back. Then we can tackle the donations together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything new while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll keep helping folks stay in the loop if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll watch for any updates while I’m running errands and pass them along if I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Nell — I’ll bring the old drill and a few extra screws, and I’ll check in if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I heard that, and I’ll keep an ear out if anything else gets added to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Nell — I’ll stick with the drill and screws, and I’ll check in if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ll sort the tools and make a short list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — can you also note which tools need light cleaning?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can note that too. I’ll keep it brief and just mark the ones that need a quick clean.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely, Sam — if you could bring any spare tools or parts you’ve got, that’d help a lot. I’ll check back later and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. I’ll see what I can bring by later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Lovely, Uli — I’ll swing by later and let you know what they’re still missing. Hopefully we can fill the gaps before the day’s out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—I can help carry things over if you need another set of hands, and I’ll keep an ear out for anything else you might need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — can you just help carry the drop-off boxes over? I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I can carry the drop-off boxes over, just point me where to take them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — just send the plan and drop-off time when it’s ready, and I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll line it up after the school run and send you the plan and drop-off time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — take your time, and I’ll be ready when you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got it — duct tape, screws, and a box cutter if I can find one. I’m good for now, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just keep me posted if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer, screwdriver set, wrench, and tape measure, and I’m free after lunch to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — Saturday after lunch works, and the drill plus wrench set would be perfect. Can you also bring the tape measure in case we need it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the drill, wrench set, and tape measure on Saturday after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which repair tasks need attention first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — the roof leak and broken porch step come first, and we can leave the fence and gutters for later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — roof leak and porch step first, and we’ll save the fence and gutters for later.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli—let’s start with the cabinet hinge, and I’ll take the tape after that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, let’s do the hinge first, then the tape. I’ll point you to the screws and screwdriver once we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, point me to the hinge and I’ll get started—then I’ll grab the tape and check the screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ve still got screws and tape on the list, so a basic screwdriver would help too if you can bring it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll bring screws, tape, and a basic screwdriver when I swing by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks — that covers the list for now. See you when you get here, even if you’re a little late.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — send me the first drop-off spot when you have it, and I’ll keep a running list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — the first drop-off is the community center lobby, and I’ll send more spots as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center lobby is first on the list. Send the next drop-off spot whenever you have it, and I’ll keep tracking them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — send me the time when you know it, and I’ll plan around pickup to be there after.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Faye — I’ll send the time as soon as I know it, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Gus — just let me know when you’ve got the time, and I’ll work around pickup and be there after.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Opal — I’ll be ready when you send the spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m on it, Noah — I’m checking the collection point now, and I’ll send you the exact spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll be ready when you send the spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll start inviting folks and tell them the tool-sorting help is needed. Let’s make this repair drive a real community effort!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I can help sort tools or set up—just let me know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll let folks know we need help sorting tools and setting up, and I’ll send them your way. This’ll be a real neighborhood effort!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — just let me know if anything else comes up before then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Sam — I’ll keep you posted if anything else pops up before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess — I’m on standby and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Rosa — I’ll start with the tools on the left table.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’s a big help. I’ll send the updated Sunday details for the community center as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep sorting here and wait for Sam to help match them up.
